field_text_formatted.value: Route building got slow with a lot of exposed views (#3484714, patch by jacobbell84). Every rebuild looked up each view's resource type from scratch, once per view per entity type. Caching it per entity type instead: 637 calls to ResourceTypeRepository::get() down to 13, at the scale the issue reported.
